public.question: What is S-CORE?
public.answer: S-CORE is centralized request and service management system used to submit, route, process, and monitor organizational requests.

public.question: How do I submit a request?
public.answer: You may submit request after signing in by opening Create Request, selecting request type, completing required fields, and clicking Submit.

public.question: Do I need an account to use S-CORE?
public.answer: Yes. You need valid account to submit and track requests. Public users may only view limited information without sign-in.

public.question: What information is required in request form?
public.answer: Provide clear title, complete description, request type, unit or office target when required, due date if applicable, and supporting files.

public.question: What file types can be uploaded?
public.answer: Allowed formats depend on server policy. Common supported files include PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, and JPG within configured size limits.

public.question: How can I track request status?
public.answer: After sign-in, open My Requests and review status badge, timeline updates, and latest action note for each request.

public.question: I cannot sign in. What should I do?
public.answer: Verify credentials first. If issue continues, use password recovery or contact administrator to confirm account status and access role.

public.question: How are notifications delivered?
public.answer: System sends in-app notifications for request updates, assignments, comments, and status changes. Delivery timing depends on event trigger.

public.question: Where can I get support?
public.answer: Please contact your unit focal person or system administrator. Include request ID, issue summary, and screenshot for faster resolution.

public.question: What are account role types in S-CORE?
public.answer: Main role types are User, Unit, and Admin. User submits requests, Unit processes assigned work, and Admin manages system-wide operations.

user.question: How do I create a new request?
user.answer: Open Create Request page, choose request type, enter complete details, attach required files, then submit for routing.

user.question: How do I check status of my request?
user.answer: Go to My Requests and open request record. You can review current status, action timeline, assigned unit, and latest remarks.

user.question: Can I edit request after submission?
user.answer: Editing depends on current status. If request is still open for revision, use Edit action. Otherwise submit clarification through comment or message.

user.question: Can I cancel my request?
user.answer: Yes, if request has not reached locked processing stage. Open request details and use Cancel action when available.

user.question: How do I upload supporting files?
user.answer: In request form, use attachment section, select files, and wait for upload completion before final submission.

user.question: What should I do if upload fails?
user.answer: Check file size and type first, then retry with stable connection. If failure continues, report exact error to support.

user.question: I forgot my password. How can I recover account?
user.answer: Use password recovery option on sign-in page. If recovery is restricted, contact administrator for secure reset.

user.question: How do I receive updates on my request?
user.answer: Enable notifications and monitor in-app alert panel. System posts updates whenever request status or assignment changes.

user.question: How do I reply to unit comments?
user.answer: Open request thread and add concise response with required clarification or evidence, then submit comment.

user.question: What does each request status mean?
user.answer: Pending means waiting action, In Progress means processing started, Completed means fulfillment done, Rejected means not approved, Cancelled means withdrawn.

user.question: Can I change my profile information?
user.answer: Yes. Open profile settings and update allowed fields. Role and restricted identity fields may require administrator action.

user.question: How do I contact support from user account?
user.answer: Use support channel defined by your organization and provide request ID, issue description, and screenshot.

unit.question: How do I view assigned requests?
unit.answer: Open unit dashboard and review assigned queue. You may filter by status, priority, requester, and date.

unit.question: How do I update request status as unit?
unit.answer: Open request detail, select appropriate status transition, add action note, and save update for audit trace.

unit.question: How do I request clarification from requester?
unit.answer: Use comment or message channel in request record, specify missing details, and set status requiring user response.

unit.question: How do I mark request as completed?
unit.answer: Confirm all deliverables first, upload final evidence if required, set status to Completed, and include completion summary.

unit.question: When should unit reject request?
unit.answer: Reject only when request violates policy, lacks mandatory criteria after clarification, or falls outside authorized scope.

unit.question: How do I prioritize unit workload?
unit.answer: Prioritize by policy urgency, due date, impact level, and dependencies. Keep queue updated with accurate status.

unit.question: Can unit attach files during processing?
unit.answer: Yes. Unit may upload supporting evidence, output documents, or references as part of processing record.

unit.question: How are unit actions audited?
unit.answer: System records status changes, timestamps, actor identity, and notes. Maintain clear entries for accountability.

unit.question: How do I reassign request inside unit?
unit.answer: Use assignment control if enabled, select responsible unit member, and add note explaining reassignment reason.

unit.question: Who can manage unit account access?
unit.answer: Administrator manages role privileges and activation. Unit leads may request access updates through proper channel.

unit.question: How do I handle overdue requests?
unit.answer: Review overdue queue, update status immediately, communicate blockers, and escalate high-impact cases to administrator when required.

unit.question: How does unit communicate with requester?
unit.answer: Use built-in comment or message tools in request record to keep communication documented and traceable.

admin.question: How do I manage user accounts?
admin.answer: Open admin user management, create or update profiles, assign roles, and activate or deactivate accounts based on policy.

admin.question: How do I configure request statuses and types?
admin.answer: Use admin configuration page to update request types, statuses, and related metadata, then save and validate in workflow.

admin.question: How do I export reports?
admin.answer: Go to reports module, set filters, choose export format such as Excel or PDF, then generate file.

admin.question: How do I reset or update system settings?
admin.answer: Use admin settings panel. Apply changes carefully, review impact by module, then save and verify expected behavior.

admin.question: How do I import or export chatbot settings?
admin.answer: In chatbot configuration, download template or export current file, then import edited JSON to apply config and flows.

admin.question: How do I monitor request performance?
admin.answer: Use analytics and reports to review volume, turnaround, completion rate, and backlog indicators by unit and period.

admin.question: How do I grant admin or unit roles?
admin.answer: Assign roles from user management with proper authorization. Confirm least-privilege principle before applying elevated access.

admin.question: How do I troubleshoot system access issues?
admin.answer: Check account state, role mapping, session validity, and recent configuration changes. Review logs for exact failure path.

admin.question: How do I handle overdue requests across units?
admin.answer: Use overdue view, identify bottlenecks, coordinate with unit leads, and enforce escalation timeline for critical items.

admin.question: How do I archive old data?
admin.answer: Use configured archiving controls to move eligible historical records according to retention policy and compliance requirements.

admin.question: How do I maintain consistent service standards?
admin.answer: Define measurable SLAs, monitor dashboard metrics, review exceptions, and enforce corrective actions through governance process.

admin.question: How do I support users and units effectively?
admin.answer: Provide clear policy guidance, maintain updated configuration, respond to escalations quickly, and keep communication channels documented.
